topic: Which restaurants near King's Cross station in London have a private room?

text: Morning. I've been asked to sort the London dinner venue. Which restaurants near King's Cross station have a private room? Budget's the one we agreed, so nothing fancy.
Private room for 9 or are we just getting a table at the back and shouting over each other
A private room is worth it if people want to do a toast or anything. Otherwise a long table in a decent place is fine. What's the per head figure we settled on?
£55 a head including drinks 🙂
Thats tight for london

@claude Which restaurants near King's Cross station in London have a private dining room for about 9 people? Ideally around £55 a head including drinks, and please say whether the room is bookable online or only by phone.

I couldn't confirm any King's Cross venue that offers about £55 a head including drinks. None of the pages I opened showed an all-in per-head price. I also couldn't confirm a phone-only booking route for any of them. The three below are the ones I opened. The other venues I came across (Hawksmoor St Pancras, Midland Grand, The Lighterman) are only from search snippets, so I haven't checked them.

**Drake & Morgan, King's Cross**
- The private dining room takes up to 15 guests, so 9 fits.
- The page gives a minimum spend from £750 per session, including VAT, plus a 12.5% service charge. For 9 people that's about £83 a head if you only just meet the minimum.
- The venue supplies the drinks, and you can't bring your own.
- Booking goes through an "Enquire now" form on Tagvenue, not instant online booking. The page doesn't list a phone number. ([Tagvenue](https://tagvenue.com/rooms/london/2399/drake-morgan-at-kings-cross/private-dining-room))

**Rotunda Bar & Restaurant (York Way)**
- The private room seats up to 30, or 16 at one long table.
- Evening sessions start from a £1,500 minimum spend. Sharing menus start from £60 a head. A 13.5% service charge applies, and a 50% deposit is required.
- Booking is by enquiry form, and the pricing was last updated 7 months ago. ([Tagvenue](https://www.tagvenue.com/rooms/london/72585/rotunda-bar-and-restaurant/private-dining-w-terrace))

**Granary Square Brasserie (The Stirling Room)**
- The listing I opened was a general King's Cross hire page, not the room's own page, so I couldn't see this room's capacity or price. A search snippet said prices start at £60 a head before drinks, but I haven't verified that.

Tagvenue's general King's Cross page shows a "Check availability" button on its listings, but I couldn't tell whether that means instant booking. Both rooms I checked individually were enquiry-only. ([Tagvenue King's Cross](https://tagvenue.com/rooms/london/90854/granary-square-brasserie/the-stirling-room))

Your £55 budget is probably tight for these rooms. I'd email or call Drake & Morgan and ask for a quote for 9 people, with drinks included and the minimum spend waived or reduced. A midweek lunch might get you closer to £55.

@claude Could you find restaurants near King's Cross station with a long table or private room for about 9 people on a Thursday evening, with no minimum spend and people paying for their own drinks? Ideally around £55 a head for food. Also please check the last direct train from London to Manchester on Thursday 3 December, and whether it leaves from Euston or Piccadilly.

I couldn't confirm either part of this. I'd treat both as unchecked.

**Train: last direct Euston to Manchester on Thursday 3 December**
- I couldn't get a time. The [Avanti West Coast Euston–Manchester page](https://www.avantiwestcoast.co.uk/travel-information/train-times/london-euston/Manchester-Piccadilly) failed to load its live times when I opened it.
- **Station:** Direct trains to Manchester leave from **London Euston** and arrive at **Manchester Piccadilly**. Piccadilly is the arrival station, not the departure station. That comes from the route pages I found, and I didn't see a date-specific source for it.
- **Last departure:** Other sites gave conflicting last times, from about 22:03 to later in the night. I couldn't tell which of those were direct or specific to that date, so I wouldn't rely on any of them. Check the Avanti or National Rail journey planner, filtered to direct trains. Engineering works are common in winter.

**Restaurants near King's Cross for 9 people**
- **Drake & Morgan King's Cross** is the best lead I found. Its [SquareMeal listing](https://www.squaremeal.co.uk/private-group-dining/drake-morgan-at-kings-cross_215) shows a private dining room for up to 14 and doesn't list a minimum spend. The venue-wide average is £30–£49 a head, which is below your £55 target. The listing says prices are for guidance only. The page I opened mostly describes karaoke packages, and a £10 a head deposit applies to those. I couldn't confirm that you'd pay for your own drinks, so ask them.
- **Ruled out:** [Porte Noire](https://www.tagvenue.com/rooms/greater-london/117850/porte-noire-kings-cross/indoor-dining) is listed with a £500 minimum spend. [Rotunda](https://www.tagvenue.com/rooms/london/72585/rotunda-bar-and-restaurant/private-dining-w-terrace?event-offer=wedding) has minimum spends that vary by day and time. I didn't check Thursday evening specifically.
- **Not checked:** The [Tagvenue King's Cross list](https://www.tagvenue.com/hire/restaurants-with-private-rooms/london/king-s-cross) also includes Hawksmoor St Pancras and Camino. I didn't open their pages, so I know nothing about their minimum spends.

When you contact Drake & Morgan, ask for a Thursday 3 December booking for 9 with no minimum spend, a set menu at about £55 a head, and drinks paid for separately.
